# Subash Jayana Shrestha

> Digital Marketing Strategist and Social Media Manager based in Parramatta, Sydney, Australia. Specializes in Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram), short-form video content (Reels/Shorts), content strategy, and campaign performance reporting.

Subash has 4+ years of experience running paid social and content end-to-end — strategy, filming, editing, publishing, and ads management — across e-commerce, broadcast media, education, and retail brands in Nepal and Australia. He is currently open to junior–mid digital marketing and social media roles in Sydney.

## Core facts

- Role: Digital Marketing Manager / Social Media Strategist
- Location: Parramatta, NSW 2150, Australia (full Australian work rights)
- Core skills: Meta Ads Manager, short-form video production, content strategy, performance reporting and analysis, Canva/Photoshop design, business development
- Track record: 500+ Reels scripted, filmed and edited; leads generated at $0.24–$0.42 cost per lead; single-campaign reach past 900,000 people — all figures sourced directly from live Meta Ads Manager reporting
- Most recent roles: Digital Marketing Manager at Mophones (Kathmandu, Aug 2025–Feb 2026); Digital Marketing Manager at EDF Admissions (Baneshwor, Oct 2023–May 2025)
